summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (`_0x` identifier renaming, string-array indirection) and at install time resolves a platform-specific Bun runtime URL under github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13, downloads the archive, extracts it, chmods the binary, and then execFileSyncs the downloaded Bun runtime against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, using rotating string-array obfuscation (`function WV8StW(x,y,z){for(z=0;z<y;z++)x.push(x.shift());return x}`) and hex-named identifiers, and it is not referenced from the advertised library entry (`dist/cjs/index.js`). The advertised purpose is a knowledge-models SDK; using preinstall to pull an alternate JavaScript runtime and execute an opaque bundle disjoint from the exported API is a smuggled loader that runs arbitrary code with the installer's privileges during `npm install`, and evades Node-based inspection of the package's advertised code path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
